title: Final project: build your own training service desk
goal: Demonstrate a connected operator workflow with own data, settings and persistent results.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 7; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: A user route connects a card, document and report row. Follow a particular number to its customer and minutes, then preserve a result that can be reopened. The existing A4 note, A5 rows and A6 description become preservation checks.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Use only your synthetic service. Main 440/225/215 and new independent 400/420 are different sets and evidence; do not force them to agree. Preserve the original, DT/CF, attempts and previous work; restore only into a new empty target. Nexus stores a note and independent A/Pprogress; it neither executes external 1C nor awards instructor grades.

sections.title: Delivery connects learned actions
paragraphs: The final instance combines catalogs, a request document, input rules and a reproducible report. Complete the workflow without bypassing UI through manual database edits. Extra domains do not add value without requirements and tests. Work identity and provenance distinguish the submission from its starter template.

Use your final copy. Create two distinct customer codes, a third equal-named control, one/two services and the 12 requests. Record actual platform numbers: F1–F12 are observation labels, not required numeric-field input.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Use your own installed 1C result and independent controls.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Create own items, record codes and distinguish the equal-named customer. Expected: Identities defined.
Step 2. Enter 12 controlled requests with references / date / status; save and reopen actual numbers. Expected: 12 requests/440 minutes persisted.
Step 3. Generate 225/215 and explain source keys. The empty third customer yields no requests. Expected: Report agrees with source.
Step 4. Apply one own additive change and repeat earlier scenarios while retaining the source. Expected: Independent change verified without losing the core.

sections.title: Data should distinguish scenarios
paragraphs: Use 12 requests including zero, multiple statuses and equal names with different references. Identical rows let wrong filters pass accidentally. The dataset must distinguishAND fromOR, detail from groups and minutes from cost. Preserve identities alongside totals to explain each reported row.

Demonstrate opening a customer, selecting it in a request, writing, closing, finding by number, then filtering a report and explaining source documents. Follow your variant’s extra requirements. If using work rows, explicitly specify their relation to the header: automatic totals are absent from the starter.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: Two cards have equal names. May one reference replace the other if the total looks good?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. A name helps a person, but a reference determines request membership. The empty equal-named card must remain without requests. Compare numbers and references after reopening.

sections.title: Demonstrate persistence
paragraphs: Create a request, close and reopen it by identity, then restart the session. Changes must persist. Separately show rejected input and absence of a write. A Nexus note is not a 1C infobase: distinguish work-copy references, source files and native execution evidence.

Make your extension in another copy of the accepted core, such as an optional service description or improved form layout. Predict scope first and reconcile earlier documents/report afterward. Do not overwrite your work with a third-party or ready-made solution for a screenshot.

Demonstrate actual records, independent checks and recovery separately.

sections.title: Submit a minimal complete package
paragraphs: Submit requirements, your configuration / source, synthetic data, report parameters, check table and recovery proof. Exclude the 1C platform, third-party configurations and licenses. Document environment limitations and unperformed checks. File size and screen count do not replace reproducibility from a fresh copy.

Deliver only own configuration / source, synthetic data description, report settings, checks and recovery instructions. Exclude platform installers / licenses. Studio can preserve/export source, while actual data operations and BSL run in installed 1C.

paragraphs: In your new final-work copy continuing A7, open A71000003 and trace its Beta customer, service, date, status and 15 minutes to the report row. Compare all 12 numbers with the independent 400; expect no customer rows for the empty Alpha. Check the previous A4 note, A52000005 rows and A6 service description. Preserve sources/provenance and your observation table separately from the reference; exclude installers and licenses.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: Main 12/440→455 is a prior pinned experiment, not claimed as a fresh execution. The fresh independent DTcopy continues accepted A7: 12/400. After two refused invalid writes, only Beta 15→35 was intentionally changed: copy 12/420, original 12/400. All 12 identities, other fields, A4 note, A5 rows and A6 description persist. A complete manual wizard/learner defense was not checked.
